svg.title: Default univariate animal-model path
svg.desc: Flowchart of the default univariate animal model: pedigree and phenotype enter an hsquared formula, Julia REML returns variance components, heritability, and breeding values. Genomic and multivariate paths are not shown.

svg.text: Intervals, when shown, are experimental asymptotic (not coverage-calibrated). Registration in Julia General is deferred - do not Pkg.add("HSquared") by name.
